sideB.text:
HIDDEN STOCKPILE

Take up to 6 Supply cubes from the reserve and add them to a location containing a player pawn.

Play at any time. Not an action.
sideB.footer: Play at any time. Not an action.

mechanics.whenRead: The next Rationed Event in the deck after the February pause (02-07). Add it to the Rationed Event pool when drawing reaches it. 02-07 itself does not say that events follow.
